challenges.title: Robust Percentile Normalization
challenges.problem: Normalize a NumPy array using low/high percentiles computed from finite values only. Map low percentile to 0, high to 1, clip to [0,1], and preserve NaN positions.
requirements: If no finite values, return all-NaN.
If selected percentiles are equal, every finite output is 0.0.
challenges.function_signature: def robust_percentile_normalize(x: np.ndarray, low: float = 1.0, high: float = 99.0) -> np.ndarray:
challenges.reference_answer:
import numpy as np
def robust_percentile_normalize(x, low=1.0, high=99.0):
    if not (0 <= low < high <= 100): raise ValueError
    a=np.asarray(x); out=np.full(a.shape,np.nan,dtype=np.float64); m=np.isfinite(a)
    if not m.any(): return out
    v=a[m].astype(np.float64,copy=False); lo,hi=np.percentile(v,[low,high])
    if hi==lo: out[m]=0.0
    else: out[m]=np.clip((v-lo)/(hi-lo),0,1)
    return out

challenges.title: Soft-Argmax 2D Keypoints
challenges.problem: For heatmaps (B,K,H,W), apply softmax over H*W after temperature scaling and return expected pixel coordinates (x,y).
challenges.function_signature: def soft_argmax_2d(heatmaps: torch.Tensor, temperature: float = 1.0) -> torch.Tensor:
challenges.reference_answer:
import torch
def soft_argmax_2d(heatmaps,temperature=1.0):
    if heatmaps.ndim!=4 or temperature<=0: raise ValueError
    b,k,h,w=heatmaps.shape; p=torch.softmax(heatmaps.reshape(b,k,-1)/temperature,dim=-1)
    ys=torch.arange(h,device=heatmaps.device,dtype=heatmaps.dtype); xs=torch.arange(w,device=heatmaps.device,dtype=heatmaps.dtype)
    yy,xx=torch.meshgrid(ys,xs,indexing='ij')
    return torch.stack([(p*xx.reshape(1,1,-1)).sum(-1),(p*yy.reshape(1,1,-1)).sum(-1)],dim=-1)

challenges.title: Transform Boxes Through Crop and Resize
challenges.problem: Clip xyxy boxes to a crop, drop non-positive clipped boxes, then resize the crop to out_size=(out_w,out_h).
challenges.function_signature: def transform_boxes_crop_resize(boxes: np.ndarray, crop: tuple, out_size: tuple) -> np.ndarray:
challenges.reference_answer:
import numpy as np
def transform_boxes_crop_resize(boxes,crop,out_size):
    b=np.asarray(boxes,dtype=np.float64)
    if b.ndim!=2 or b.shape[1]!=4: raise ValueError
    x0,y0,x1,y1=map(float,crop); ow,oh=map(float,out_size)
    if x1<=x0 or y1<=y0 or ow<=0 or oh<=0: raise ValueError
    q=b.copy(); q[:,0]=np.clip(q[:,0],x0,x1); q[:,2]=np.clip(q[:,2],x0,x1); q[:,1]=np.clip(q[:,1],y0,y1); q[:,3]=np.clip(q[:,3],y0,y1)
    q=q[(q[:,2]>q[:,0])&(q[:,3]>q[:,1])]
    q[:,[0,2]]=(q[:,[0,2]]-x0)*(ow/(x1-x0)); q[:,[1,3]]=(q[:,[1,3]]-y0)*(oh/(y1-y0)); return q

challenges.title: Camera Ray-Plane Intersection
challenges.problem: Convert pixels to camera rays with K^-1, rotate rays to world coordinates with R_cw, and intersect them with world plane n dot X + d = 0.
requirements: Reject parallel rays and intersections behind camera.
challenges.function_signature: def intersect_camera_rays_with_plane(K: np.ndarray, R_cw: np.ndarray, C_w: np.ndarray, pixels: np.ndarray, n: np.ndarray, d: float) -> np.ndarray:
challenges.reference_answer:
import numpy as np
def intersect_camera_rays_with_plane(K,R_cw,C_w,pixels,n,d):
    K=np.asarray(K,float); R=np.asarray(R_cw,float); C=np.asarray(C_w,float).reshape(-1); p=np.asarray(pixels,float); n=np.asarray(n,float).reshape(-1)
    if K.shape!=(3,3) or R.shape!=(3,3) or C.shape!=(3,) or n.shape!=(3,) or p.ndim!=2 or p.shape[1]!=2: raise ValueError
    dirs=(np.linalg.inv(K)@np.c_[p,np.ones(len(p))].T).T; dirs=(R@dirs.T).T; den=dirs@n; num=-(C@n+float(d))
    if np.any(np.isclose(den,0)): raise ValueError
    tt=num/den
    if np.any(tt<=0): raise ValueError
    return C[None,:]+tt[:,None]*dirs

challenges.title: Depth Consistency Mask
challenges.problem: For aligned depth maps a,b, return mask where both are finite/positive and abs(a-b)/max(a,b) <= threshold.
challenges.function_signature: def depth_consistency_mask(depth_a: np.ndarray, depth_b: np.ndarray, threshold: float = 0.05) -> np.ndarray:
challenges.reference_answer:
import numpy as np
def depth_consistency_mask(depth_a,depth_b,threshold=0.05):
    a=np.asarray(depth_a,float); b=np.asarray(depth_b,float)
    if a.shape!=b.shape or threshold<0: raise ValueError
    m=np.isfinite(a)&np.isfinite(b)&(a>0)&(b>0); out=np.zeros(a.shape,bool); d=np.maximum(a[m],b[m]); out[m]=np.abs(a[m]-b[m])/d<=threshold; return out

challenges.title: Global-Norm Gradient Clipping
challenges.problem: Compute total L2 norm across all existing gradients and scale gradients in-place only if norm exceeds max_norm.
requirements: Return pre-clipping norm as Python float.
challenges.function_signature: def clip_grad_global_norm_(parameters, max_norm: float, eps: float = 1e-6) -> float:
challenges.reference_answer:
import torch
def clip_grad_global_norm_(parameters,max_norm,eps=1e-6):
    if max_norm<0: raise ValueError
    g=[p.grad for p in list(parameters) if getattr(p,'grad',None) is not None]
    if not g: return 0.0
    dev=g[0].device; sq=torch.zeros((),device=dev,dtype=torch.float64)
    for x in g:
        if x.device!=dev: raise ValueError
        sq+=x.detach().double().pow(2).sum()
    n=float(torch.sqrt(sq).item())
    if n>max_norm:
        s=max_norm/(n+eps)
        for x in g: x.mul_(s)
    return n

challenges.title: 2D Sinusoidal Positional Encoding
challenges.problem: Create (H,W,D) deterministic 2D sinusoidal encoding: first D/2 channels encode y, last D/2 encode x, alternating sin/cos using standard transformer frequencies.
challenges.function_signature: def sinusoidal_2d_position_encoding(height: int, width: int, dim: int) -> np.ndarray:
challenges.reference_answer:
import numpy as np
def sinusoidal_2d_position_encoding(height,width,dim):
    if height<=0 or width<=0 or dim<=0 or dim%4: raise ValueError
    half=dim//2; idx=np.arange(0,half,2,dtype=np.float64); div=np.exp(-np.log(10000.0)*idx/half)
    y=np.arange(height,dtype=np.float64)[:,None]; x=np.arange(width,dtype=np.float64)[:,None]; ey=np.zeros((height,half)); ex=np.zeros((width,half))
    ey[:,0::2]=np.sin(y*div); ey[:,1::2]=np.cos(y*div); ex[:,0::2]=np.sin(x*div); ex[:,1::2]=np.cos(x*div)
    out=np.empty((height,width,dim)); out[:,:,:half]=ey[:,None,:]; out[:,:,half:]=ex[None,:,:]; return out

challenges.title: Temperature-Scaled Softmax
challenges.problem: Apply scalar temperature scaling to logits and return numerically stable probabilities.
challenges.function_signature: def temperature_scaled_softmax(logits: np.ndarray, temperature: float) -> np.ndarray:
challenges.reference_answer:
import numpy as np
def temperature_scaled_softmax(logits,temperature):
    x=np.asarray(logits,dtype=np.float64)
    if x.ndim<1 or x.shape[-1]<2 or not np.isfinite(temperature) or temperature<=0: raise ValueError
    z=x/temperature; z-=np.max(z,axis=-1,keepdims=True); e=np.exp(z); return e/e.sum(axis=-1,keepdims=True)

challenges.title: Greedy Cost Matching With Threshold
challenges.problem: Repeatedly choose the globally smallest remaining finite cost. If it is <= max_cost, match row/column and remove them; otherwise stop. Ties use row-major order.
challenges.reference_answer:
import numpy as np
def greedy_cost_match(cost,max_cost):
    c=np.asarray(cost,dtype=np.float64)
    if c.ndim!=2 or not np.isfinite(c).all() or not np.isfinite(max_cost): raise ValueError
    rows=list(range(c.shape[0])); cols=list(range(c.shape[1])); m=[]
    while rows and cols:
        sub=c[np.ix_(rows,cols)]; flat=int(np.argmin(sub)); i,j=np.unravel_index(flat,sub.shape)
        if sub[i,j]>max_cost: break
        m.append((rows[i],cols[j])); del rows[i]; del cols[j]
    return m,rows,cols

challenges.title: Warmup Cosine LR Multiplier
challenges.problem: For integer step in [0,total_steps], linearly warm from 0 to 1 by warmup_steps, then cosine-decay to min_ratio at total_steps.
requirements: If warmup_steps=0, step 0 starts at 1 before cosine decay.
challenges.function_signature: def warmup_cosine_multiplier(step: int, total_steps: int, warmup_steps: int = 0, min_ratio: float = 0.0) -> float:
challenges.reference_answer:
import math
def warmup_cosine_multiplier(step,total_steps,warmup_steps=0,min_ratio=0.0):
    if not isinstance(step,int) or isinstance(step,bool) or not isinstance(total_steps,int) or not isinstance(warmup_steps,int): raise ValueError
    if total_steps<=0 or not (0<=warmup_steps<total_steps) or not (0<=min_ratio<=1) or not (0<=step<=total_steps): raise ValueError
    if warmup_steps>0 and step<=warmup_steps: return step/warmup_steps
    p=(step-warmup_steps)/(total_steps-warmup_steps)
    return min_ratio+(1-min_ratio)*0.5*(1+math.cos(math.pi*p))
